Central.reason: CENTRAL LINE: Saturday 26 September & Sunday 27 September, no service (including Saturday Night Tube) between Liverpool Street and Woodford / Newbury Park. Replacement buses operate. For Night journeys to Wanstead, Redbridge and Gants Hill, please use Night Bus Route N8.

District.reason: District Line: No service between Earl's Court and Kensington (Olympia) due to train cancellations. Tickets are being accepted on the Mildmay line (West Brompton - Willesden Junction) and on London Buses. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

DLR.reason: DOCKLANDS LIGHT RAILWAY: Sunday 27 September, no service between Shadwell and Tower Gateway.

Elizabeth line.reason: ELIZABETH LINE: Sunday 27 September, from 0800, a reduced service operates between Paddington and Heathrow Terminal 4 / Maidenhead. Two trains an hour serve Heathrow Terminal 4, West Drayton, Langley, Slough, Burnham and Maidenhead. Four trains an hour serve Acton Main Line, West Ealing, Hanwell and Heathrow Terminals 2 and 3. Six trains an hour serve Ealing Broadway, Southall and Hayes & Harlington.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: Minor delays between Moor Park and Watford due to train cancellations. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Mildmay.reason: Mildmay Line: Minor delays between Willesden Junction and Clapham Junction due to a fire alert near Wandsworth Road. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Piccadilly.reason: PICCADILLY LINE: From 0200 Saturday 26 and all day Sunday 27 September (including Friday and Saturday Night Tube), no service between Cockfosters and Uxbridge. Trains continue to operate between Acton Town and Heathrow. Use DISTRICT LINE trains between Central London and Acton Town / Ealing Common and METROPOLITAN LINE trains between Rayners Lane and Uxbridge. Use ELIZABETH LINE trains for travel between Central London and Heathrow. Replacement buses operate.

Victoria.reason: Victoria Line: Minor delays due to a track fault at Brixton.

Waterloo & City.reason: Waterloo & City line: service operates 06:00 until 00:30, Monday to Friday only. There is no service on Saturdays, Sundays and on bank/public holidays.

Weaver.reason: WEAVER LINE: Saturday 26 September, all day, and Sunday 27 September, from 1015, no service between Hackney Downs and Cheshunt / Enfield Town. The limited number of GREATER ANGLIA and STANSTED EXPRESS trains which usually stop at Seven Sisters will stop at Tottenham Hale instead. Use London Underground connections between Central London and Seven Sisters, and for Rectory Road and Stoke Newington, use Clapton station. If travelling to the Big Bang concert at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, please use Victoria line trains to/from Seven Sisters or Tottenham Hale.

Windrush.reason: Windrush Line: No service between Wandsworth Road and Clapham Junction due to a fire alert near Wandsworth Road. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.
